title: At Your Service Center Associate, Mall in Columbia - Part Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an At Your Service Center Colleague, you are at the heart of delivering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. You’ll support all At Your Service activities, including Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS), merchandise returns, order pickups, and other assigned tasks - all while upholding Macy’s service standards.

This role requires strong multitasking abilities, problem-solving, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment where flexibility is key, including working a variety of shifts such as nights, weekends, and holidays.

This role goes far beyond just being a cashier. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

How Our At Your Service Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.
  • In the At Your Service area, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships. Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by recovering merchandise and keeping the pickup and return areas clean while ensuring timely completion and curbside delivery of Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS) orders.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Makes prompt, sound decisions in real time to effectively address customer needs and resolve issues
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to an inclusive work environment.

title: Country Manager
description:
Squad Makers is scaling from a high-touch services model into a structured, scalable SaaS + certified squad ecosystem. After several years validating the model in Spain and building a strong Spanish-speaking senior developer network, the company is now expanding internationally with a clear three-pillar strategy.

The expansion plan focuses on entering high-demand markets like the U.S. Europe and Ibero-America, building local Country Managers to drive partnerships and revenue, while leveraging centralized operational excellence. The goal is simple: scale revenue without compromising quality, and become the reference model for certified, AI-driven remote squads globally.

The Country Manager at Squad Makers leads market expansion in a specific country, owning growth, strategic partnerships, and execution quality.

They drive new client acquisition and build a strong partner ecosystem, positioning Squad Makers through three key differentiators:

Squad Challenge certification: a standardized technical validation process that helps clients and partners reduce hiring risk, accelerate staffing, and ensure consistent quality across squads.

EOR (Employer of Record) hiring: enables clients to scale teams fast without dealing with local contracts, compliance, payroll, or administrative overhead — Squad Makers manages it end-to-end.

Enabling Team: a senior layer (product, engineering, QA/DevOps, delivery) that mentors squads, anticipates sprint risks, enforces best practices, and keeps technical debt under control to ensure reliable outcomes.

In short: win the market, activate partners, scale teams safely via EOR, and protect delivery with the Enabling Team.

BizDev & P&L | Partnerships | Delivery Leadership | Entrepreneurial Execution

title: Senior Credit Risk Anlytics Specialist
description:
We are looking for an analytical and detail-oriented Credit Risk Analytics Specialist to join our team's Risk team. This role is responsible for independently monitoring the Bank's credit risk profile, analysing portfolio performance, validating key risk information and supporting effective risk oversight through data-driven insights and reporting. Working closely with internal stakeholders, you will help identify emerging risks, enhance reporting capabilities and contribute to sound risk management practices.


Responsibilities

  • Independently monitor the Bank's retail credit portfolio, ensuring exposures remain within approved risk appetite and internal risk frameworks.
  • Analyse portfolio performance by reviewing trends in arrears, defaults, recoveries, utilisation, delinquency and other key credit risk indicators.
  • Validate and reconcile credit risk information from multiple data sources to ensure accuracy, completeness and consistency.
  • Review management information produced by the First Line of Defence, providing independent analysis and constructive challenge where appropriate.
  • Prepare meaningful analytical reports and dashboards to support management, committees and senior decision-makers.
  • Identify emerging risks, unusual portfolio trends and data quality issues, recommending appropriate actions where required.
  • Review credit risk classifications, impairment assessments and provisioning outputs, ensuring alignment with internal policies and regulatory standards.
  • Support stress testing exercises, risk appetite monitoring, ICAAP activities and other regulatory risk management initiatives.
  • Monitor the progress of agreed risk actions, ensuring recommendations are implemented within agreed timelines.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of risk reporting, portfolio analytics and credit risk monitoring processes.


Requirements

  • Degree in Banking & Finance, Risk Management, Mathematics, Statistics or another quantitative discipline.
  • Around 3–5 years' experience within Credit Risk, Credit Portfolio Analytics, Risk Reporting or a similar analytical role in banking.
  • Experience working with retail lending portfolios, including credit cards or other unsecured lending products.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large volumes of data and identify meaningful risk trends.
  • Experience using analytical and reporting tools such as SQL, Power BI, Tableau, SAS or Python.
  • Good understanding of credit risk concepts including default, impairment, provisioning, loan staging, PD, LGD, EAD and IFRS 9.
  • Knowledge of banking regulations and credit risk frameworks, including CRR/CRD and EBA Guidelines, would be considered an advantage.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present findings clearly to different stakeholders.
  • Highly organised, detail-oriented and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • A proactive mindset with the confidence to independently assess information, challenge assumptions and recommend improvements.

title: Chief Engineer - Harvester Systems
description:
Chief Engineer – Harvester Systems
Oxford, NC (On-site + Field Work)
Ag Equipment | Early-Stage | Hardware + Autonomy
Competitive Salary + Meaningful Equity

Let's Build the Harvester Farmers Have Been Waiting For

We're creating a new kind of harvester — one built for small farms and specialty crops that delivers clean grain, honest performance, and modern technology without trapping farmers in closed ecosystems.

This is a clean-sheet machine that brings together serious mechanical excellence, smart embedded sensing, and thoughtful AI-driven optimization. It's designed for operators who want control, easy serviceability, and the right to repair.

We're looking for a Chief Engineer who will take this from prototype to production and build the team that brings it to life. If you're smart, hungry, and humble — someone who loves getting their hands dirty, obsesses over details, and genuinely wants to make farmers' lives better — we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Do

  • Own the entire harvester from architecture through production and into the field
  • Design threshing and separation systems that deliver consistently clean grain across different crops and conditions
  • Create machines that feel intuitive and friendly to operators, easy to adjust in the field, and simple to service without needing a dealer
  • Lead the integration of mechanical systems with embedded sensors that actually deliver useful, open data
  • Run real-world field testing across regions and take full ownership of hitting tough targets on grain loss, quality, and throughput
  • Hire, mentor, and lead a high-performing core engineering team

What You Bring

Required

  • 10+ years designing agricultural equipment
  • 5+ years specifically hands-on with harvesters, combines, or threshing/separation systems
  • Deep mechanical intuition for how these systems work in the real world
  • Strong CAD skills paired with serious hands-on build and test experience
  • A proven ability to lead technical teams while staying humble and collaborative
  • Genuine excitement about spending time in harvest conditions (mud, dust, long days, big smiles)

Preferred

  • Experience with ISOBUS or CAN systems
  • Background integrating sensors or machine vision
  • Familiarity with grain loss and quality measurement

Why You'll Love This Role

This is a rare chance to define the philosophy of a machine that puts performance, openness, and operator respect first. You'll help build the first product in what will become a broader on-farm platform.

You'll work side-by-side with founders who bring together aerospace rigor, real ag experience, and smart manufacturing thinking. Together, we'll challenge decades of legacy design decisions and create something farmers truly need.

If you're the kind of leader who's brilliant but never arrogant, driven but always willing to listen, and technically outstanding while remaining deeply grounded — this role was made for you.

Note: Candidates without direct harvester or threshing system experience will not be considered. Relocation assistance is available for exceptional candidates.

description:
COMPANY PROFILE

Sporticulture is a sports licensing and consumer products company operating at the intersection of sports fandom, lifestyle, and everyday retail. We design, develop, and distribute officially licensed merchandise across some of the most recognized leagues and programs in professional and collegiate sports -- including the NFL, MLB, NHL, and major NCAA organizations.

Our mission is to bring team pride into the products fans use every day. From home decor to seasonal collections, Sporticulture connects passionate sports fans with high-quality, officially licensed consumer goods that reflect their loyalty to the teams they love.

We operate in a retail-driven environment where strong execution across Walmart systems (Retail Link and Supplier One), compliance, and data accuracy are critical to success.

Product Lines

Sporticulture's product portfolio spans multiple consumer lifestyle categories, each designed to showcase team loyalty in everyday environments:

  • Home Decor -- team-branded merchandise for living rooms, offices, and fan caves
  • Seasonal & Holiday Decor -- officially licensed collections for every season and celebration
  • Crafts & Novelty Items -- creative and collectible fan products for all age groups
  • Lighting -- team-branded indoor and outdoor lighting solutions
  • Horticulture-Inspired Merchandise -- a signature category blending sports fandom with garden and plant culture

Retail Distribution

Sporticulture products are available through premier national retail and e-commerce partners including Walmart, Amazon, Rally House, Kroger, Target, Fanatics, and other major retailers -- reaching millions of sports fans across the United States through both in-store and online channels.

Our Walmart business relies heavily on Retail Link and Supplier One for item setup, supplier onboarding, compliance management, and ongoing account operations.

JOB SUMMARY

Sporticulture is seeking a Retail Link Consultant to support Walmart retail operations by analyzing data, optimizing inventory performance, and improving overall account efficiency using the Walmart Retail Link platform.

This role includes the full lifecycle of Walmart account setup -- from new item creation and supplier onboarding to factory compliance and system configuration -- followed by ongoing management of purchase orders, shipments, and account health.

This is an analytical and insight-driven role, best suited for a detail-oriented professional with proven hands-on experience navigating Walmart Retail Link.

You will monitor inventory across multiple product categories, identify trends and risks, and deliver clear, actionable reporting that helps Sporticulture optimize its Walmart account performance.

The ideal candidate goes beyond basic reporting -- you proactively surface insights, flag issues before they escalate, and collaborate across operations, supply chain, and sales to drive smarter retail execution. If you are highly organized, data-savvy, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, this role is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a growing national retail account.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Core Responsibilities

  • Set up and configure Walmart Retail Link and Supplier One accounts, including initial system onboarding
  • Manage new product/item setup, ensuring accuracy of all product data and attributes
  • Oversee factory onboarding, compliance requirements, and supplier documentation within Walmart systems
  • Analyze Walmart Retail Link data including sales performance, inventory levels, and item-level metrics
  • Monitor inventory across multiple product categories including home, seasonal, craft, novelty, and lighting
  • Manage purchase orders (POs), shipment tracking, and fulfillment processes within Walmart systems
  • Identify sales trends, emerging risks, and actionable opportunities across retail channels
  • Generate accurate, timely reports and dashboards for internal stakeholders and leadership
  • Collaborate with operations and supply chain teams to improve retail execution and fill rates

Additional Responsibilities

  • Support demand planning and sales forecasting across Walmart product categories
  • Identify and resolve data inconsistencies, reporting gaps, and inventory discrepancies
  • Improve reporting workflows and explore automation opportunities for recurring processes
  • Provide strategic insights to improve product sell-through rates and retail placement
  • Support retail strategy development and account planning for Walmart partnerships
  • Ensure ongoing compliance with Walmart requirements, including item maintenance, supplier updates, and system accuracy
  • Maintain and update all product, supplier, and shipment data to ensure alignment across Retail Link and Supplier One

Scope of Role

This role is focused on both system setup and ongoing account management -- not manual warehouse operations.

You will be responsible for building the Walmart system foundation from the ground up, including item setup, supplier onboarding, and compliance structures, and then managing day-to-day operations such as POs, shipments, and data accuracy.

You will work cross-functionally with operations, supply chain, and sales teams to ensure Sporticulture's Walmart account performs at its highest potential.

title: Microsoft Business Central Developer
description:
The Role

We're a small team running our entire operation on Microsoft Business Central (Essentials plan today, moving to Essentials with Tier 4 Advanced Warehousing in the near term). We're standing up a real fulfillment center and connecting Business Central to a Warehouse Management System extension to run it. We need a BC developer who can both write the AL code and deeply understand what they're doing — someone who can sit across from a physical warehouse problem and make the right call on how BC should model and process it.

This person becomes our owner of everything Business Central. In the beginning we'll hand-hold on business context (because that's the only way they can be effective). Over time, they grow into the advisor role for this entire area and become the point person on calls with our external BC consultants who are helping us plan and implement the warehouse buildout.

Must-Haves

  • Modern Business Central AL development in VS Code. Custom extensions, table/page extensions, custom API pages, codeunits, XMLports, custom permission sets, custom reports. Not NAV-only.
  • Deep, opinionated knowledge of Business Central's event-driven and data-driven architecture. Real experience subscribing to the event bus, knowing which events to hook, and understanding the downstream consequences. You should be able to teach us the nuances of BC end-to-end — inventory, warehousing, sales, purchasing, posting routines, accounting impacts.
  • Job Queue and background processing experience. AL performance hygiene matters here — FlowFields, SIFT keys, Item/Reservation Entry calc cost. We already run a deferred-update queue architecture and you need to be at home in that world.
  • Real experience with a Business Central environment that was connected to a Warehouse Management System. You should understand what that means for the BC document lifecycle (warehouse shipments, picks, put-aways, registration, posting). Direct experience with a specific WMS extension matters more than the brand. Slight preference for Insight Works Warehouse Insight or Lanham ACE WMS, but we're open.
  • Warehousing fundamentals — bin locations, slotting strategies, zone-based velocity, wave/section picking, assembly-to-order flows. You should be able to push back on us when our physical-operations idea doesn't map cleanly to BC.
  • Customizing the BC UI (page extensions, custom pages) and building custom reports.
  • Source control, CI, version management, sandbox-to-production promotion. Git/VS Code AL workflow expected.
  • Product-owner mindset. We're not looking for an order-taker. We'll bring a problem; you should think about tradeoffs between tech and physical operations and propose the pragmatic path. You should know when not to build something custom.
  • Excellent English. Fluent, comfortable, and — most importantly — concise. We value people who know when to talk and when to stop. Grammar perfection isn't the bar; communication quality is.
  • Comfortable working with AI tools, heavily. We're an AI-forward team and we want you using AI to speed up your workflow as much as you can. That said, we don't believe AI is perfect — attention to detail and knowing when AI is steering you wrong is part of the job.

Strong Bonuses

  • TrueCommerce EDI integration with Business Central — how it sits inside the BC document lifecycle. We already depend on TrueCommerce. If you can absorb that area, that's a role we don't have to hire separately for.
  • Power BI integrated with Business Central.
  • Microsoft Copilot in Business Central — bringing it in and making it usable for us.
  • Application Insights / telemetry on BC. We don't use it today; familiarity is enough.

What Experience Looks Like to Us

title: Beauty Counter Manager - MAC, Fairlane Town Center - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As a Counter Manager, you will lead a dynamic team of Beauty Advisors while managing all aspects of a specific cosmetics brand. Your role blends leadership, creativity, and customer engagement—delivering genuine hospitality through personalized consultations, expert product application, and a deep understanding of each customer’s beauty and style preferences.

You’ll inspire teamwork to drive sales and elevate the customer experience by creating meaningful, long-lasting connections. With a strong focus on client development, you will cultivate a loyal customer base through outreach, follow-up, and consistent, personalized service.

In addition to meeting and exceeding sales goals, you’ll analyze business performance, execute vendor events and promotions, and partner with vendors and store leadership to grow the business. You'll also oversee stock presentation, hygiene standards, and team performance to ensure an exceptional and polished brand experience.

How Our Counter Managers Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As a Counter Manager, you come in energized and ready to inspire your team - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting colleagues with genuine warmth, and ensuring your counter is polished, organized, and fully prepared to welcome customers. You set the tone by reviewing daily sales goals, staying informed on new launches, top-performing products, and current beauty trends - so you're equipped to lead with confidence, support your team, and deliver exceptional service to every customer.
  • On the floor, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships.
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by ensuring testers are clean and well-stocked, signage and pricing are current, and displays reflect brand standards. You lead by example, jumping in to support merchandising updates and keeping the space visually appealing and welcoming throughout the day.
  • You help the team Finish Strong - by coaching them to share Loyalty benefits, making sure customers leave with everything they need, and ending each interaction with a sincere thank-you, often using the customer’s name and adding a personal touch.
  • You know that service starts with each other. You model collaboration, honesty, and care - supporting your peers so the whole team can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are and What You Will Do

  • Deliver exceptional customer service through personalized consultations and expert product knowledge
  • Build lasting relationships with clients and drive client development through outreach and follow-up
  • Review and analyze business performance of daily, weekly, monthly, seasonal, and annual sales results and implement strategies to grow business and improve results
  • Plan and execute in-store and vendor-led events to drive traffic and engagement
  • Maintain brand standards through proper merchandising, hygiene, and stock replenishment
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Collaborate with vendors, personal stylists, and store leadership to optimize outcomes
  • Resolve customer concerns in a professional and customer-first manner
  • Stay informed on new launches, best-sellers, and beauty trends to support team education
  • Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with strong attention to detail
  • Demonstrate flexibility, sound judgment, and a passion for the beauty industry
  • 3–5 years of relevant retail, beauty, or leadership experience preferred
  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs., stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

title: Chief Revenue Officer
location: New Jersey, New Jersey, United States
description:
Title: Chief Revenue Officer

Location: Clifton, New Jersey and/or Remote

Pay: $250-300k OTE

The Company

This is an established fintech lender delivering flexible revenue-based financing to small businesses nationwide. The company moves fast, cuts through bureaucracy, and provides capital that actually helps entrepreneurs grow—without rigid credit boxes or endless paperwork. With a proven model, strong revenue foundation, and fresh capital in place, the business is poised to accelerate.

The foundation is solid. Now comes the push to scale: build a direct sales engine, deepen domestic growth, and expand deliberately into international markets where demand is high and competition remains limited.

The Opportunity

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Chief Revenue Officer becomes the senior commercial leader who owns the full revenue engine. This is a builder’s role. The CEO has driven commercial efforts hands-on; the right CRO steps in as a true peer to design strategy, create the team, deliver results, and position the company for its next chapter of growth.

This is not about managing from the top. It is about architecting the revenue function while rolling up sleeves alongside the team—sourcing deals, building relationships, and executing at every level with strategic vision, relentless drive, and disciplined follow-through. Success here means creating real impact through both leadership and personal contribution.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Strategy and Commercial Leadership

Develop and lead a comprehensive revenue plan across direct sales, partnerships, and new markets. Own the commercial P&L, set ambitious yet achievable targets, and partner with the CEO on business planning and resource decisions. Stay sharp on market shifts, competitors, and customer needs to keep the company ahead.

Direct Sales: Build and Lead

Design and scale a high-performing direct sales organization starting from zero. Define structure, hiring profiles, compensation, and standards. Lead from the front initially—sourcing and closing deals personally—then transition to coaching and leading a growing team. Build processes and tools that create consistency and predictability while keeping the entrepreneurial edge. Full ownership of direct sales outcomes, with real accountability and significant upside.

Strategic Partnerships and Business Development

Identify and secure high-value partners such as accounting firms, referral networks, and channel distributors. Leverage and expand existing industry relationships to accelerate early wins, then build a repeatable playbook for broader execution. Aim to close four to six meaningful partnerships in the first year.

International Market Expansion

Own go-to-market for international growth, starting with Canada and targeting entry before the end of 2027. Evaluate and sequence additional markets including the UK, Australia, and New Zealand. Adapt the approach, build local relationships, and partner closely with compliance and product teams to launch successfully.

Organizational Development

Attract, develop, and retain exceptional talent across sales and business development. Create a culture grounded in ownership, curiosity, and high standards—one where people take initiative, learn quickly, and deliver results together. Put in place the metrics, systems, and visibility that let everyone see progress clearly.

Ideal Candidate Profile

A proven commercial leader who thrives building rather than maintaining. Someone who combines clear strategic thinking with the willingness to roll up sleeves and execute at every level.

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership in commercial roles, with recent experience as CRO, VP Sales, VP Partnerships, or Head of Business Development.

  • Strong background in fintech, alternative lending, or financial services preferred; deep execution experience in consulting or private equity also valued.

  • Track record of creating sales and BD teams from the ground up and closing complex partnership deals.

  • Robust existing network and relationships across financial services, lending, and related industries that can be brought to the table and activated immediately.

  • International market experience, especially in Canada, UK, Australia, or New Zealand, stands out.

  • Exceptional communicator who builds trust fast and operates effectively in a founder-led, high-ownership environment with a clear bias for action.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Job Title

Senior Software Engineer – Regulated AI & Enterprise SaaS

About the Product

We are building a semi-autonomous AI recruitment agent that works alongside human recruiters and existing Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).
The system is advisory-first, human-in-the-loop, and designed for regulated enterprise environments, with strong guarantees around compliance, auditability, AI safety, and bias control.

This is not a consumer AI product — it is a policy-driven, explainable, enterprise AI system.

Role Overview

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design and build core backend systems that power our AI-assisted recruitment platform, including:

  • Policy-controlled AI workflows
  • ATS integrations
  • Audit-ready decision pipelines
  • Security- and compliance-first infrastructure

You will work closely with architects, ML engineers, compliance stakeholders, and product leaders to deliver a production-grade, regulated AI platform.

Key Responsibilities

Core Engineering

  • Design and implement backend services for a single-tenant, enterprise SaaS platform
  • Build read-heavy ATS integrations (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, etc.) using APIs and webhooks
  • Implement human-in-the-loop approval workflows with full auditability
  • Develop event-driven systems for recommendations, approvals, and logging

AI & Policy Integration

  • Integrate dedicated LLM services on AWS (Bedrock / EKS-hosted models)
  • Enforce OPA/Rego-based policy decisions for:

    • AI safety
    • Bias control
    • Autonomy limits
  • Ensure no AI action bypasses policy evaluation

Compliance & Safety

  • Implement immutable audit logs (append-only)
  • Support GDPR workflows (right to explanation, right to delete)
  • Encode EEOC-safe hiring constraints into software logic
  • Build systems that are inspectable, explainable, and regulator-friendly

Security & Reliability

  • Implement tenant-isolated data access patterns
  • Apply secure-by-default design (IAM, KMS, encryption, RBAC)
  • Participate in threat modeling and abuse scenario mitigation
  • Build for SOC2 / ISO-style audits

Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • 5+ years of backend software engineering experience
  • Strong experience with:

    • Distributed systems
    • API design (REST/GraphQL)
    • Event-driven architectures
  • Proficiency in one or more:

    • Java / Kotlin
    • Go
    • Python
    • Node.js (TypeScript)

Policy & Compliance Awareness

  • Experience working with regulated systems (fintech, healthtech, HR tech, govtech)
  • Familiarity with:

    • OPA / Rego (strong plus)
    • RBAC / ABAC authorization models
    • Audit logging and compliance controls

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Strong AWS experience:

    • VPC, IAM, KMS
    • RDS / DynamoDB
    • ECS / EKS
  • Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform / CDK)

Preferred / Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI/ML system integration (not necessarily training models)
  • Familiarity with:

    • SOC2, GDPR, EEOC, ISO 27001
    • Human-in-the-loop AI systems
    • Explainable AI or model governance
  • Prior work on ATS, HR, or workflow automation platforms
  • Experience building single-tenant enterprise SaaS

What Makes This Role Different

  • You are not building a chatbot
  • You are building a policy-governed AI system where:

    • Safety > speed
    • Explainability > raw automation
    • Compliance is a core feature, not an add-on
  • Your code may be reviewed by:

    • Auditors
    • Legal teams
    • Enterprise security teams

What Success Looks Like

  • No AI recommendation is produced without policy validation
  • Every action is explainable, traceable, and auditable
  • Recruiters trust the system — and regulators can inspect it
  • The platform scales without sacrificing safety or compliance

Ideal Candidate Mindset

  • Thinks in systems, not features
  • Comfortable saying this should fail closed
  • Understands that doing nothing is sometimes the safest action
  • Treats compliance constraints as engineering inputs, not obstacles

title: Senior AI Data Scientist/Engineer
description:
We're currently looking for a Senior AI Data Scientist / Engineer to join our team for a full-time position (remotely in Ukraine or in Lviv's office).

About the Customer and the Project:

Our customer is the world's largest DNA network, based in the USA. This presents a unique opportunity to work with more than 60 billion digitized global historical records, 100 million family trees, and 18+ million people in their growing database. Our customers help people discover their family stories and gain actionable insights about their health and wellness.

About the team:

You will join the AI Content team, a dynamic group at the forefront of Document Understanding. You'll play a vital role in developing innovative AI models that extract and organize text and image information from billions of historical and genealogical records, enabling customers to discover, share, and connect with their family history.

As a member of the team, you will work with KB (Knowledge Base) and RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) implementations, integrating architectures leveraging SQL-structured databases along with vector databases supporting semantic search and retrieval applications. You will work with a dedicated mentor from the data science team, as well as engineering teams, to train, optimize, and deploy models that promote product development, customer success, and content creation across our project.

What you will do:

  • Configure structured and vector databases: Align and sync database schemas across structured and vector databases
  • Curate and organize content collection metadata: Prepare and format provided content collection metadata to be compatible with defined database schemas
  • Ingest content collection metadata: Ingest collection metadata from provided sources into a structured SQL database.
  • Embeddings generation: Help develop a tool/script to generate embeddings from the structured data to populate the vector database.
  • Iterative improvement: Iterate on adjusting the database schema, indexes, embeddings, etc., to support various queries and use cases for analyzing the ingested content collection metadata
  • Collaborate on Cloud Deployment: Partner closely with ML Ops and Data Science Engineers to seamlessly deploy datasets, truth sets, models, and pipelines for training and inference in cloud environments.
  • Communicate Insights Effectively: Clearly and confidently present your findings, deliverables, and proposed solutions to technical and non-technical audiences, including teams, stakeholders, and executives.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Science
  • Strong hands-on commercial experience with LLMs in production, RAG architecture, and agentic systems
  • Expertise with data collection, organization, curation, and formatting to populate SQL databases.
  • Experience with SQL databases, including adjusting schemas and indices to optimize for efficient queries.
  • Familiar with embedding generation and use of vector databases for semantic search and retrieval.
  • Strong proficiency and experience with Python and relevant tools and libraries
  • Practical experience with cloud platform AWS (e.g. Amazon SageMaker, EC2, S3, AWS Lambda).
  • English: Upper-intermediate at least (both spoken and written)

It will be a plus:

  • Knowledge and experience with cloud platforms and related AI/ML services such as Google GCP Gemini API, Vertex AI, Azure, etc.
  • Strong knowledge and experience with LightLLM
  • Commercial experience with Terraform or CloudFormation
  • Experience with agentic web scraping tools

What You'll Gain

  • Mentorship & Growth: Learn from experienced Data Scientists while tackling meaningful, real-world AI projects, expanding your knowledge and professional network within a collaborative culture.
  • Collaboration & Impact: Work alongside top industry professionals and help shape the tools that bring family history to life for millions of users.
  • Innovation & Purpose: Join a team at the forefront of applying AI to historical data where every model you build helps preserve human stories.

What do we offer our new colleague?

  • Competitive compensation (based on market data, but also depending on the technical level of the candidate)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • 3 health packages to choos frome
  • Annual paid vacation and state holiday celebration
  • Free English classes (online)
  • Individual approach to professional growth
  • Lack of bureaucracy and micromanagement
  • Modern, comfortable office facilities (a barbecue zone, kitchens, lounge rooms, coffee machines, etc.)
  • Foreign business trips (after the war)
  • On-site parking lot and charge station for Electric Cars
  • Corporate gifts, celebrations, and fun activities
  • Sports activities: ping-pong, soccer, work-out

Suppose you have a passion for solving challenging problems, building scalable, robust systems, love working with the latest technologies in a fast-paced, flexible environment, and are excited about the prospect of having a significant impact on products with more than 3 million paying subscribers.

In that case, we want to talk to you! ;-)

title: At Your Service Center Associate, Stonebriar Centre - Part Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an At Your Service Center Colleague, you are at the heart of delivering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. You’ll support all At Your Service activities, including Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS), merchandise returns, order pickups, and other assigned tasks - all while upholding Macy’s service standards.

This role requires strong multitasking abilities, problem-solving, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment where flexibility is key, including working a variety of shifts such as nights, weekends, and holidays.

This role goes far beyond just being a cashier. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

How Our At Your Service Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.
  • In the At Your Service area, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships. Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by recovering merchandise and keeping the pickup and return areas clean while ensuring timely completion and curbside delivery of Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS) orders.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Makes prompt, sound decisions in real time to effectively address customer needs and resolve issues
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to an inclusive work environment.

title: Hebrew/English Content Moderator
description:

As a Content Moderator, you will play a crucial role in maintaining the quality and safety of digital content across our platforms. You will apply content policies meticulously, ensuring consistency in handling procedures and enforcing client terms of use. Your keen ability to discern nuances in digital communication will be instrumental in accurately moderating reports of abuse and inappropriate content.

  • Apply content policies to assess age-appropriateness, violence, sexual content, and political transparency.
  • Participate actively in wellness programs and training sessions aimed at personal and professional development.

  • High school diploma or equivalent.

  • - Flight tickets to Thessaloniki will be bought in advance by the company

    - Up to 350 gross for the real estate agency fee (for when they find their permanent accommodation)﻿

  • lunch vouchers 85 EUR monthly
    Transportation allowance 65 EUR monthly
  • Private health care.

Benefits:

  • Permanent contract.
  • Additional PTO for birthdays.
  • Comprehensive wellness programs and counseling services.
  • Dynamic work environment with regular team activities and celebrations.

Important Notes:﻿

  • Training: Begins on November 7th, Application deadline by October 15th.

You will join as the first dedicated CRM hire, take hands-on ownership of lifecycle communication and retention, and create the strategy, processes, reporting, and technical foundation for a future team. This role can suit an experienced CRM Head, a CRM Lead ready for broader ownership, or a strong Senior CRM Manager with the judgment and ambition to build a function from the ground up.

This is a build-first leadership role. At the beginning, you will be the CRM team and will work directly in the tools while setting the direction for the function. As the business grows, you will hire and lead the team needed to scale. We value people who combine strategic judgment with careful execution, use data to challenge assumptions, and create systems that remain practical in a fast-moving company.


Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the CRM and player lifecycle strategy across onboarding, activation, conversion, retention, reactivation, loyalty, and churn prevention.
  • Build the initial CRM operation hands-on, including audience selection, campaign setup, content briefs, quality assurance, scheduling, launch, and post-campaign analysis.
  • Design player segments and automated journeys based on behaviour, value, product preferences, lifecycle stage, market, risk indicators, and communication permissions.
  • Own the campaign calendar across email, SMS, push notifications, on-site messaging, and other relevant channels.
  • Partner with casino, sportsbook, VIP, product, marketing, payments, customer support, and analytics teams to create relevant and commercially effective player communication.
  • Work with product and technology teams on CRM platform implementation, data flows, event tracking, integrations, templates, personalization, and automation.
  • Establish CRM KPIs and reporting for delivery, engagement, conversion, retention, reactivation, player value, bonus efficiency, and incremental campaign impact.
  • Develop a structured testing program covering messaging, offers, timing, channels, frequency, segments, and customer journeys.
  • Ensure campaigns follow market-specific advertising rules, data-protection and consent requirements, responsible gaming controls, AML considerations, and internal approval processes.
  • Document workflows, ownership, quality checks, campaign logic, and reporting standards so the function can scale reliably.
  • Define the future CRM team structure, hire and onboard team members as the business grows, and develop clear responsibilities and performance expectations.

What success looks like

  • A working CRM engine Core lifecycle journeys, campaign routines, templates, data inputs, and reporting operate reliably without depending on ad hoc manual decisions.
  • Measurable retention CRM activity improves activation, repeat engagement, retention, reactivation, and player value with clear evidence of incremental impact.
  • Relevant communication Players receive timely and personalized messages based on behaviour, preferences, market rules, and appropriate frequency controls.
  • A scalable function Processes and tools are documented, hiring priorities are clear, and new team members can take ownership without rebuilding the foundation.


Requirements

  • Strong experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, retention, or player engagement, ideally within iGaming or another high-frequency digital consumer business.
  • Hands-on ability to plan, build, launch, validate, and analyze campaigns rather than working only through a team or agency.
  • Selecting or implementing a CRM or marketing automation platform and defining its data and integration requirements.
  • Building a CRM team, mentoring specialists, or moving from a senior individual-contributor role into functional leadership.
  • Working across multiple markets, brands, languages, products, or regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience with loyalty programs, VIP journeys, bonus strategy, predictive segmentation, or customer lifetime value modelling.
  • Experience with segmentation, automated journeys, personalization, campaign calendars, experimentation, and multi-channel communication.
  • Commercial understanding of lifecycle KPIs, retention, churn, player value, conversion, bonus efficiency, and campaign incrementality.
  • Confidence working with CRM platforms, customer data, event tracking, analytics tools, and technical teams responsible for integrations.
  • Strong understanding of consent, communication preferences, responsible gaming, and compliant promotional practices in regulated markets.
  • Leading CRM for an online casino, sportsbook, fintech, subscription product, or other regulated digital platform.
  • Clear English communication and the ability to coordinate effectively with commercial, product, technical, operational, and compliance stakeholders.
  • A practical, independent working style suited to a startup where priorities evolve and the first version often needs to be built personally.
  • Willingness to work from the office in Limassol.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate business workflows into AI solutions
  • Strong systems thinking and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail with a focus on execution and delivery
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced, concurrent environments
  • Developer or technical background with hands-on implementation experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with ChatGPT, OpenAI APIs, or other automation platforms

  • Familiarity with workflow automation tools (Zapier, Make, Notion AI, etc.)
  • Basic technical or scripting knowledge (Python, JavaScript, or similar)
  • Experience working cross-functionally across multiple business teams
  • Experience working within Microsoft infrastructure (Azure, Microsoft 365, Power Platform
  • Experience building knowledge bases or internal documentation systems
  • Experience developing or deploying AI agents or copilots within business environments

title: Head of Media Buying
description:
Our client is a structured, well‑established online gaming group with a decades‑long presence across their core markets. Operating multiple brands in Casino, Live Casino and Sportsbook. They are now seeking to recruit a Head of Media Buying to join their team in Malta.

Overview of the role

The Head of Media Buy leads the company's media buying function, with a particular emphasis on innovative and alternative media buying techniques and strategies for an offshore licensed iGaming operator. Working alongside an established in-house design team and automation capability, the role brings a proactive, handson approach to acquiring traffic: continuously developing new strategies to buy advertising and drive direct conversion for the company's brands. The Head of Media Buy is accountable for media buy strategy, for the acquisition landing pages that convert paid traffic, for tracking, and for transparent reporting of spend and return on investment.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the Media Buy team and set its strategic focus on black-hat media buying, through both in-house setups and external sources.
  • Develop and execute black-hat strategies for campaign delivery, covering both seasonal and evergreen activity, and renew them continuously.
  • Manage campaigns directly, setting the standard for the team in campaign build, optimisation and scaling.
  • Build and maintain the technical and account infrastructure on which black-hat buying depends, ensuring resilience when platforms or networks change their policies.
  • Document tactics and processes in playbooks, so that performance does not depend on any single individual.
  • Major platforms: Meta, Google and YouTube, Bing, TikTok and X, plus Telegram, WhatsApp, ChatGPT, Reddit.
  • Additional traffic types: native, push, pop and programmatic, direct buys with sports and odds publishers, and display campaigns in Bannerflow.
  • New sources and markets: competitor and market research to find new sources, a channel mix tailored to each market including DACH, Brazil and Turkey, and scale, pause or discontinue decisions on the data.
  • Own the media buy landing pages for Acquisition. Design and development are delivered by in-house designers and developers; the Head of Media Buy ensures the pages remain current.
  • Partner with the Head of SEO to ensure sufficient landing page coverage for the traffic being purchased.
  • Provide input for landing page tests, and apply the findings to improve conversion.
  • Work with Netrefer on tracking, ensuring every campaign is measured from click through to registration, FTD and NGR.
  • Be accountable for the agreed targets: FTDs, NGR, cost per FTD and cost per registration.
  • Provide reporting on request at any time, with full transparency on where budget is spent and the return it delivers.
  • Produce regular dashboards and weekly performance reports across all campaigns.
  • Own the media buy budget, agreeing the split across channels with the Head of Acquisition and monitoring pacing and spend daily.
  • Approve spend only against agreed budgets, maintaining a clear audit trail for every top-up, payment and spend movement.
  • Reconcile spend against platform and network records and invoices, and escalate any variance immediately.
  • Maintain documented records of access to ad accounts and payment methods.
  • Work closely with the Head of Social Media, who owns communications strategy and white-hat media buying with a separate budget, so that both functions operate in alignment.
  • Work directly with the AI Creative Lead on all campaign creatives, including briefs, variants and performance feedback.
  • Lead the Media Buy team, setting priorities, reviewing work regularly and providing coaching.
  • Maintain availability and responsiveness during core working hours, and set the same expectation for the team.


Requirements

  • 5+ years' experience in performance media buying, including a proven record in black-hat or non-standard media buying in iGaming or other restricted verticals, supported by demonstrable results.
  • Hands-on proficiency across multiple traffic types and platforms, such as Meta, YouTube, Telegram, native, push and programmatic.
  • Strong knowledge of tracking and attribution, including postbacks, UTMs and server-side tracking.
  • Experience leading a media buying team and managing significant monthly advertising budgets with clear controls.
  • Strong financial discipline, with spend documented, reconciled and explained proactively.
  • A proactive, accountable approach, with prompt responsiveness and open collaboration with colleagues.
  • Advantageous: media buying experience in the DACH region, Brazil and Turkey, although not limited to these markets; iGaming experience across several markets; and experience hiring and developing media buyers.

Do you have a passion for data-driven marketing, thrive on improving user experiences, and have a proven track record of increasing conversion rates across digital platforms? If so, keep reading to learn more about this exciting opportunity!

Who We Are

At Trustona Media, we create content that people love and search engines understand, operating several online publications for a variety of audiences, including Cloudwards (cloud-based tech reviews) and Coffeeness (all things coffee). We have around 50 team members of editors, writers, designers and we keep adding more every month! Because of this growth, our team needs more help.

We're currently looking for a German/English bilingual Conversion Optimization Specialist to join our team and help us elevate our lead conversion strategy. In this role, you will be the conversion gatekeeper of our posts and pages, taking full ownership of our sites’ UX and functionalities. The ideal candidate will have prior experience in CRO, with a demonstrable track record of building positive results.

Our Websites

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and skilled conversion optimization specialist to join our team. This will be a freelance contractor role with around 30-40 hours of commitment each week.

A typical day as the Conversion Optimization Specialist will involve reviewing key performance metrics such as conversion rates and user behavior, followed by team meetings to discuss ongoing projects and test results. You'll set up new A/B or multivariate tests, analyze data, and summarize findings to guide future strategies. Throughout the day, you'll focus on optimizing conversion paths, preparing detailed reports, conducting competitor analysis, and staying updated on industry trends.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement conversion rate optimization strategies to increase lead generation, improve user experience, and maximize ROI across web and mobile platforms.

  • Use tools like Google Analytics 4 and Microsoft Clarity to assess website and landing page performance, identifying areas for improvement.

  • Plan, create, and run A/B and multivariate tests to evaluate the effectiveness of different strategies, layouts, and content to enhance conversion rates.

  • Conduct AP testing and research other websites to identify what works, what could work for us, and what might not be suitable.

  • Generate and propose creative ideas aimed at improving conversions, clicks, and overall user engagement.

  • Collaborate with the team to improve website flow and layout based on data insights, ensuring a seamless user experience across all devices.

  • Analyze and enhance conversion paths for various marketing campaigns, such as popups and emails, to improve overall performance.

  • Generate actionable reports detailing test results, CRO initiatives, and overall site performance for internal teams and management.

  • Stay updated on industry trends, tools, and best practices in conversion optimization, conducting regular competitor analysis to stay ahead.

Required Skills

  • Proven experience in conversion optimization with a track record of positive results.

  • Strong English and German proficiency.

  • Proficiency in data analysis and web analytics tools such as Google Analytics and Hotjar.

  • Strong understanding of user behavior and experience with heatmaps, session recordings, and customer journey mapping.

  • Knowledge of conversion funnel optimization and how to increase lead generation and customer acquisition at each stage.

  • Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for collaborating on test implementation and site changes.

  • Strong project management skills to coordinate with cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with marketing, design, and development teams.

  • Keen attention to detail, ensuring accuracy in data analysis and test setup.

  • Problem-solving skills to identify issues and propose creative solutions.

  • Strong reporting and presentation skills to generate clear, actionable insights for stakeholders.

  • Eagerness to stay up-to-date with CRO tools, trends, and best practices.

Why Join Us?

Consistent and Reliable Pay: We pay all our freelance team members promptly by the first of each month this means a consistent and reliable paycheck.

Work Remotely: We are a fully remote team with workers all over the world, from California and Mexico to Kenya and Cyprus. As long as you have a consistent WiFi connection, where you live is up to you.

Set Your Own Schedule: Great people don’t necessarily do their best work by staring at a monitor for eight hours straight every day. You’ll have the flexibility to design a schedule that allows you to do your best work, as long as you are able to regularly communicate with the team and meet your deadlines.

Join a Fun, Diverse Team: We’re a fun bunch, and we are also a team that fosters inclusion and celebrates diversity. Here, you can be yourself. Trustona Media does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

The position pay starts at 15 EUR per hour, depending on experience.

title: Manager, IT
description:
IronSite is a full-service perimeter security partner: we design, fabricate, install, integrate, and support gates, fencing, crash-rated barriers, and access systems. Founded in 1998 as Westcoast Gate, we now generate more than $100M in revenue across 18 locations in California, Oregon, Washington, Idaho, Colorado, and Texas, with 17,000+ projects completed in the past five years.

Our customers include data centers, utilities, self-storage, corporate and distribution centers, stadiums, government, energy, and multi-family properties. IronSite is backed by Aurora Capital Partners. We live by our CARES values: Collaboration, Accountability, Responsiveness, Excellence, and Safety.

Role overview

We are consolidating onto Acumatica as our single ERP and field service platform, retiring Procore, and standardizing how 18 branches schedule, bill, and report. The IT Manager makes that consolidation stick and turns our systems into a competitive advantage.

You will partner with Field Service, Regional Operations, Engineering, Procurement, Finance, and EHS. Success means technicians have what they need in the field, leaders get accurate data without spreadsheet workarounds, and our security posture holds up to customer audits and diligence. Our data center, utility, and government customers increasingly expect it.

Key responsibilities

Business systems and applications

  • Own Acumatica administration (ERP, work orders, scheduling, billing, project accounting) alongside functional owners in Field Service and Finance.
  • Complete the Procore sunset: archive project records, confirm data retention, and move remaining workflows into Acumatica and Smartsheet.
  • Manage integrations among Acumatica, Smartsheet, Microsoft 365, Vector (safety), and T3 fleet telematics.
  • Build reporting that gives leaders reliable data on utilization, on-time delivery, margin, and safety.
  • Standardize system configuration and workflows across branches with the Center of Excellence.

Infrastructure and end-user support

  • Run networks, Wi-Fi, phones, and printers across 18 offices, shops, and warehouses.
  • Own the Microsoft 365 tenant: identity, email, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive, licensing.
  • Deliver responsive helpdesk support, with priority on field technicians and crews.
  • Manage the lifecycle of laptops, tablets, mobile phones, and field devices with Procurement & Asset Management.
  • Support design and engineering tools (CAD and related software) and fabrication shop systems.

Cybersecurity and risk

  • Maintain the security program: MFA, endpoint protection, patching, backups, and access reviews.
  • Lead security awareness training and phishing simulations for all employees.
  • Own incident response and disaster recovery plans, and test them at least annually.
  • Answer customer security questionnaires and audits for data center, utility, and government work.
  • Support cyber insurance renewals and lender/investor diligence.

Vendors, budget, and governance

  • Manage MSPs, carriers, software vendors, and contracts with Procurement.
  • Build and manage the annual IT budget; consolidate tools and licenses to cut cost.
  • Set and enforce IT policies: acceptable use, access, data retention, device standards.
  • Plan and execute IT integration for future acquisitions.
  • Maintain a 12–24 month IT roadmap aligned to company priorities.

What success looks like

Timeframe Outcomes

30 days Visited key branches; inventoried systems, licenses, vendors, and contracts; met every COO direct report; listed top 10 risks and quick wins.

90 days Procore fully retired with records archived; MFA on 100% of accounts; tested backups for critical systems; helpdesk SLAs and ticket tracking live.

180 days Acumatica integrations and core dashboards stable; security policies and incident response plan approved; 12–24 month IT roadmap and budget approved.

12 months Measurable tool and license savings; field user satisfaction tracked and improving; clean results on customer security reviews and insurance renewal; repeatable acquisition IT playbook.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years in IT, including 3+ years leading IT for a multi-site company.
  • Hands-on administration of a cloud ERP; Acumatica strongly preferred (NetSuite, Dynamics, or similar considered).
  • Strong Microsoft 365 and Entra ID (Azure AD) administration.
  • Practical cybersecurity experience: MFA, endpoint protection, backup and recovery, access control.
  • Experience managing MSPs and software vendors, contracts, and budgets.
  • Ability to explain technical issues in plain language to field crews and executives alike.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel to branches.

Preferred

  • Background in construction, field service, manufacturing, or other industries with mobile field workforces.
  • Experience with Smartsheet, field service mobile apps, fleet telematics, or safety software.
  • Experience supporting acquisitions or private equity-backed companies.
  • Familiarity with NIST CSF, CIS Controls, or customer security frameworks used by data centers and utilities.
  • Bachelor's degree in IT or a related field, or equivalent experience; certifications such as Microsoft, CompTIA Security+, or ITIL a plus.

Working conditions, compensation, and EEO

Working conditions. Primarily office-based, with travel to branches estimated at 20–30%. Visits to fabrication shops, warehouses, and job sites require following IronSite safety rules and PPE requirements; every employee has Stop Work Authority. Occasional after-hours support for outages, cutovers, and security incidents.

Equal opportunity. IronSite is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

title: C-Arm (Fluoroscopy) Technician, Outpatient Surgery
description:
Orangewood Surgical Center is afast-paced, team-oriented Multi-Specialty Surgical Center located in Orange, California, right off the 57 Freeway near Angel Stadium. Our state-of-the-art facility is dedicated to delivering excellent patient care through advanced surgical technology and a collaborative clinical team. Were seeking a HIGH ENERGY Fluoroscopy Technologist who is passionate about patient care, enjoys working in a surgical environment, and brings a positive team attitude.

Position Summary
As a Fluoroscopy Technologist, you will perform imaging procedures using C-arm and fluoroscopic equipment. Your responsibilities include accurate patient positioning, equipment calibration, and ensuring compliance with safety standards. Experience with GE One or other GE fluoroscopic systems is a plus.

Key Responsibilities

  • Follow physician instructions to determine imaging areas.
  • Properly position patients and imaging equipment for procedures including pain management, orthopedics, neurosurgery, and podiatry.
  • Adhere to radiation safety protocols for patients, providers, and self.
  • Utilize shielding and best practices to minimize exposure.
  • Accurately document and maintain patient records.
  • Monitor and maintain inventory of radiology supplies; anticipate and order as needed.
  • Ensure a clean and safe working environment.
  • Track and manage dosimeter badge usage and returns.
  • Conduct and document weekly quality control checks on fluoroscopy equipment; report issues to the Administrator.
  • Support the Administrator and Clinical Manager with general duties on low-volume days.

Qualifications

  • Associates degree in Radiologic Technology or two (2) years of direct experience in the field.
  • Valid California Radiologic Technologist license.
  • Registered with the American Registry of Radiologic Technologists (ARRT).
  • Current BLS certification (Healthcare Provider CPR or CPR/AED for the Professional Rescuer).
  • Experience in trauma, fluoroscopy, and surgery preferred.
  • Must pass a background check.

Skills and Attributes

  • Proficient in general X-ray, fluoroscopy, and OR procedures.
  • Technical knowledge to calibrate and maintain imaging equipment.
  • Physical stamina and strength to assist patients and stand for long periods.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with staff, physicians, and patients.
  • Strong team player who thrives in a collaborative environment.

Join Our Team
If youre an enthusiastic and skilled technologist ready to make a meaningful impact at one of Orange Countys leading surgical centers, we want to hear from you!
